b6_reason: [Co(NH3)6]3+ has one kind of ligand so it is homoleptic and [Co(NH3)4Cl2]+ has two kinds so it is heteroleptic; both statements are correct.
b6_working: Homoleptic = metal bound to only one type of ligand; heteroleptic = more than one type. [Co(NH3)6]3+ has six NH3 only -> homoleptic. [Co(NH3)4Cl2]+ has NH3 and Cl- -> heteroleptic. Statement II states exactly this definition, so both I and II are true.
